name: grafana
description: Grafana integration — search dashboards, inspect dashboard JSON, list data sources and provisioned alert rules, and add annotations via the Grafana HTTP API.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Grafana dashboards, data sources, alert rules, and annotations

tools.name: grafana.search_dashboards
tools.description: Search dashboards by title, returning matches with their uid and folder.

query.description: Text to search dashboard titles for

tools.name: grafana.get_dashboard
tools.description: Get a single dashboard's full model and metadata by its uid.

tools.name: grafana.list_datasources
tools.description: List all configured data sources (id, uid, name, type).

tools.name: grafana.list_alert_rules
tools.description: List all provisioned Grafana-managed alert rules.

tools.name: grafana.create_annotation
tools.description: Create an annotation, optionally attached to a dashboard/panel and tagged.

dashboardUid.description: Uid of the dashboard to attach the annotation to

panelId.description: Panel id within the dashboard to attach to

tags.description: Tags to apply to the annotation
